mobbin:55855f6e-97e0-4984-9bae-f11cb21e6.summary: From Account Settings the user reaches Analytics Email Report, reads the fixed Monday-afternoon cadence, enables a per-profile toggle, and gets a success banner naming the profile and send window.
steps: Account Settings — Analytics Email Report section peeking at bottom
Fixed Monday PT cadence + Enable All + per-profile toggle off
Toggle on — success banner weekly report enabled for profile
steal: Fixed cadence copy “Emails are sent each Monday in the late afternoon (Pacific Time)” (steps 1–2) — zero-config schedule, only on/off.
Per-profile toggle + Enable All / Disable All (steps 1–2) — pause without deleting preferences.
Success banner names profile and repeats send window (step 2) — confirms what will arrive.
avoid: Burying digest under Account Settings far from Analytics (step 0) — put subscribe on the report itself for deans.
mobbin:55855f6e-97e0-4984-9bae-f11cb21e6.fit: Simplest weekly/monthly dean newsletter: one default cadence + pause toggle — not a report builder.

mobbin:a56091b1-7e85-4b1b-a790-7e7ccbea9.summary: From Analytics Overview the user starts Share Performance Report, confirms create, waits through loading plus unique-link toast, then manages public URL, auto-update, Enable Report, and copies the link.
steps: Overview — Share Performance Report CTA + Export CSV
Report settings — public URL, auto-update 24h, Enable, industry comparison
steal: Public report URL + Copy Link + view count (steps 3–4) — share without an Essentials account.
Update Report Automatically every 24h toggle (step 3) — living link instead of one-shot export.
Enable Report master switch keeps settings when paused (step 3).
Share CTA on Overview next to KPIs (step 0) — digest-by-link from the report surface, not settings.
mobbin:a56091b1-7e85-4b1b-a790-7e7ccbea9.fit: Link-shared dean/accreditation pack without accounts; auto-refresh approximates scheduled digests; industry comparison hints comparable performance without a builder.
